signals.name: Yield curve (10y-2y)
signals.reason_en: 10y-2y is +0.32pp (-0.04pp over 3 months, stable): a flat curve signals a transition; wait for the direction.
signals.rule: Inverted -> -1. Flat (0-0.5pp): flattening -> -1, steepening -> +1. Normal and steepening -> +1. Change measured over 3 months.

signals.name: Real 10y rate (10y - CPI YoY)
signals.reason_en: Real 10y = 5.12% yield - 3.7% CPI YoY = +1.40% (88th percentile of 10 years, rising over 3 months): liquidity is getting scarce relative to history.
signals.rule: Percentile vs last 10 years <= 25th -> +1 (abundant liquidity); >= 75th and rising over 3 months -> -1.

signals.name: Corporate credit spreads (CCC / BBB / AA)
signals.reason_en: CCC 13.27% (+3.49pp in 3m, 99th pct of 3m changes), BBB 1.08% (+0.11pp in 3m, 90th pct of 3m changes), AA 0.63% (+0.07pp in 3m, 82nd pct of 3m changes). CCC is widening unusually fast: junk moves first.
flags: Junk moves first: CCC is widening fast while BBB and AA have not followed yet.
signals.rule: Each spread: 3-month change above its 90th percentile -> -1, below its 10th -> +1. Combined: two agree, or CCC widening alone ('junk moves first') -> -1. Moody's Baa-10y when ICE history is too short.

signals.name: M2 money supply
signals.reason_en: M2 +0.54% MoM (-0.0 sigma vs the 0.55% average since 1959), +5.7% YoY: within the normal range.
signals.rule: Month-on-month growth in the top 5% of months since 1959 -> +1 (abnormal liquidity injection); YoY < 0 -> -1; else 0. Read as confirmation of the bond-market signals.

signals.name: VIX
signals.reason_en: VIX 16.7 (48th percentile of 10 years, +0.0 over 3 months).
signals.rule: Percentile vs 10 years >= 75th and up over 3 months -> -1; <= 25th -> +1; else 0.

signals.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
signals.reason_en: PMI 54.5 (above 50 for 9 mo), New Orders 55.3. Production 56.7 (above 50 for 11 mo); Employment 52.7 (above 50 for 3 mo); Supplier Deliveries 59.0 (above 50 for 10 mo); Inventories 48.6 (below 50 for 1 mo). Expansion with growing orders.
flags: New Orders exceed Inventories by 6.7: orders are leading.
signals.rule: PMI >= 50 and New Orders >= 50 -> +1; both < 50 -> -1; else 0. New Orders lead the headline.

signals.name: ISM Services PMI
signals.reason_en: Services PMI 54.9. Business Activity 56.5 (above 50 for 12 mo); New Orders 59.8 (above 50 for 16 mo); Employment 50.1 (above 50 for 1 mo); Supplier Deliveries 53.2 (above 50 for 22 mo). Services (~80% of the economy) are expanding.
flags: Backlog of Orders 56.6 confirms the headline.
signals.rule: Composite, Business Activity and New Orders all >= 50 -> +1; composite < 50 or both BA and NO < 50 -> -1; else 0. Backlog of Orders as confirmation.

signals.name: UMich consumer sentiment
signals.reason_en: Sentiment 48.1 (below trough zone, -1.4 in 3m); Expectations 46.3 (-4.4 in 3m): below 70 for 3+ months, consumers are pessimistic.
signals.rule: Expectations down >= 10 points in 3 months -> -1; several (3) readings < 70 -> -1; above 80 and not falling -> +1; else 0. Zones: 95-110 peak, 70-95 balanced, 55-70 trough.

signals.name: Building permits
signals.reason_en: Permits 1,400k SAAR, -3.0% YoY; 12-month average of YoY -1.2% (rising vs 3 months ago).
signals.rule: 12-month average of YoY growth > 0 and rising -> +1; YoY < 0 and the 12-month average falling -> -1; else 0 (rising/falling over 3 months).

signals.name: NFIB small business optimism + ITPM leading index
signals.reason_en: Optimism 97.9; ITPM leading index +8.2 vs 4-month average +9.0. Below 100 is a warning.
signals.rule: Optimism > 100 and the ITPM leading index (average of 5 leading components) above its 4-month average -> +1; optimism <= 95, or the ITPM index below its 4-month average and falling for 3 months -> -1; else 0.

signals.rule: YoY > +5% -> +1; YoY < -5% -> -1; else 0. Judge demand- vs supply-driven moves yourself (override).

signals.name: S&P 500 trend
signals.reason_en: S&P 500 7,757, +6.5% vs its 200-day average, +3.4% over 3 months: prices are discounting a better future.

signals.name: Euro-area Economic Sentiment (ESI)
signals.rule: >= 100 and rising over 3 months -> +1; < 100 and falling -> -1; else 0. Zones at +-1.5 SD (115 / 85).

signals.name: China PMI (RatingDog, private)
signals.reason_en: RatingDog 52.1 (+0.4 over 3 months), official NBS 50.1 (gap +2.0): private-sector manufacturing is improving.
signals.rule: RatingDog manufacturing >= 50 and rising over 3 months -> +1; < 50 and falling -> -1; else 0. The official NBS PMI is shown but not scored; 'potential lie' when official > 50 and private < 50.
